reported_issue: Games appear accelerated; sustained acceleration has not been reproduced with the available original probes.
confirmed_defects: Accelerated time debt could survive Turbo release.
Selecting normal speed did not cancel an active Turbo override.
changes: Discard timing debt on speed/reset/pause transitions.
Bound catch-up batches to two frames at 1x, retaining fractional timing phase.
Ctrl+0 selects 1x and cancels Turbo; custom hotkeys retain priority.
Show selected speed and measured speed percentage.
Add hidden Win32 wall-clock diagnostic and three original DMG/CGB probes.
Guard nested timer dispatch and inactive Turbo-key releases.

frame_pacing_test.cases: 10 simulated seconds at 60/144/240 Hz with jitter, rates 0.25x..16x, stall cap, Turbo transitions, pause/reset and invalid clocks

limitations: No affected user ROM or exact acceleration factor was provided.
Timing diagnostics use a hidden window and original probes; GPU presentation, audible quality, physical controls and real games were not verified.
A wall-clock pass allows 3 percent scheduling tolerance and does not certify every workload.
Original Boot ROMs, external services, server Hardcore, devices and code signing remain unverified.
Remote CI and Linux/sanitizer builds were not run in this stage.
